label: Rock in Rio 2026 — 04/09 (sex) · Gramado
_note_filters: Gramado only (Juan's call 2026-09-01). entry_class is deliberately unfiltered: Rock in Rio does not check ticket type at the gate, so any class is usable and the cheapest one wins. Set extra.sector to null to watch all 6 sectors.
_note_rules: ONLY lowest_ever is enabled (Juan, 2026-09-01): notify when the price drops below the lowest ever recorded, and nothing else. Each successive new low fires again — 230 -> 228 fires, then 228 -> 220 fires — because the record moves down with it. The other three rules are kept configured but disabled; flip `enabled` to re-arm one. below_threshold's price_brl is the last re-baselined value and is stale by design while disabled.
